purpose: Persist the separation between accepted provider Complete/Plan Cancel evidence and any later reviewed local Task/Objective consequence.

tables.name: wfm_source_terminal_reviews
columns: task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wfm_task_identities(task_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
provider_lifecycle_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provider_lifecycle_class IN ('complete','plan_cancel'))
state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','retain_local_work','terminate_local_work','superseded'))
local_consequence_event_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES task_execution_events(execution_event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
decided_at_utc INTEGER NULL CHECK(decided_at_utc IS NULL OR decided_at_utc>=0)
last_command_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
rules: accepted provider terminal evidence may create or supersede a pending review only when current local executable work or Objective consequence requires a decision
a pending review is bound to the exact accepted WFM source projection revision and current local execution/membership/plan-lock input fingerprint
retain_local_work records a reviewed local decision and does not modify provider status, Task execution, Task outcome or Objective membership
terminate_local_work references the exact local source_terminal_consequence execution event created by ResolveWfmSourceTerminalConsequence in the same UnitOfWork
new material source/local state supersedes stale pending review rather than editing its evidence
provider Complete/Plan Cancel alone never inserts local execution/outcome evidence

required_indexes: all FK/command columns receive LLD-01 leading-prefix coverage
